subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@acmehealth.com>, Brian Lopez <brian.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — next steps (security intake + stakeholders)

Hi Alice & Brian,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the time and context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Summary from call: Acme Health is evaluating Redwood to run clinical-document summarization and patient Q&A for a pilot across two clinics. Key concerns: PHI handling, audit logging, SLA for latency, and procurement timeline.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: technical fit (SSO, VPC options), security/compliance evidence (SOC 2, pen test summary), and commercial (TCO vs current vendor).
- Economic buyer: Brian (per call) — procurement will lead the contracting steps.

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you share the security questionnaire your team typically uses? I can have our security lead and SE fill intake answers and follow up with documentation.
2) Please confirm systems in scope (we expect: production inference API, admin console, SSO integration, telemetry/logs).
3) Stakeholder map: if you can list the names/emails for security, legal, and procurement contacts we should include, we will loop them into the kickoff.

I’ve copied Sean (AE) for contracting cadence and Neha (Solutions) + Dylan (Security lead) to own the intake.

I attached a short guide to our questionnaire ("Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Guide.pdf") to help with expectations on who provides each artifact.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Guide.pdf (stub)

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brian Lopez <brian.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Legal Team <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — next steps (security intake + stakeholders)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attaching our standard security/compliance questionnaire (fill-able). A few quick notes: 

- Systems in scope for the pilot: production inference API endpoint (public-facing with internal VPC peering), admin console (SaaS), and SSO via our existing Okta tenant. Telemetry will be ingested into our SIEM; we will need log retention and schema details.
- Economic buyer / procurement: Brian Lopez (CFO) will approve the PO and pricing. Procurement timelines are typically ~4–6 weeks once the security checklist is complete.
- Security & Legal reviewers: please loop in security@acmehealth.com and legal@acmehealth.com. Our security lead (for technical deep dives) is Dan Chen (dan.chen@acmehealth.com) — I’m copying him on the next message.

Attached: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_Fillable.docx

Best,
Alice
Director of IT Operations
Acme Health

Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_Fillable.docx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@acmehealth.com>, Brian Lopez <brian.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dan Chen <dan.chen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — security intake & kickoff

Alice / Brian / Dan —

Great — thanks for sending the questionnaire and the names. Confirming intake plan from our side:

1) We will complete the questionnaire and return the first pass within 5 business days. Neha will own technical answers (SSO, network, encryption-in-transit), Dylan will own security controls and evidence (SOC 2, incident response, pen test summaries). Sean will own commercial/procurement coordination.

2) Systems / scope (please confirm if this looks right):
   - Redwood production inference API (customer-specific namespaces, KV cache, model variants)
   - Redwood admin console (user provisioning, role-based access)
   - SSO / SAML integration with Okta
   - Telemetry & audit logs (what fields we collect and retention settings)
   - Optional: Dedicated VPC peering (if Acme requires private networking)

3) Requested artifacts we will provide alongside the questionnaire: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where appropriate), current pen test summary, data flow diagram, network architecture diagram, and our standard DPA/PO terms.

4) Proposed timeline: questionnaire returned by 2026-10-28; technical deep-dive with Dan and Neha the week of 2026-11-01; final security assessment complete by 2026-11-12 to align with your procurement window. Let us know if you need a faster cadence.

If that all looks good I’ll mark the kickoff and share a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — scheduling technical deep-dive

Dan / team —

Happy to coordinate the technical deep-dive. I have the following windows next week (all PST):
- Tue 2026-11-02: 09:00–11:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 2026-11-03: 10:00–12:00

Dylan and I will prepare a short runbook covering authentication, data flows, logging schema, and redaction/PHI handling for the call. From a capacity perspective, we do not need to involve infra beyond these sessions unless you have VPC peering questions.

Dylan: can you confirm the expected evidence turnaround?

Thanks,
Neha
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
